The operating gap

Work crosses tools. Accountability falls between them.

The target customer manages recurring operational work across disconnected systems, creating missed handoffs and weak completion visibility.

  • 64%of surveyed operations leaders said fragmented tools caused missed handoffs at least monthly.
  • 47%said they could not reliably measure whether recurring processes were completed on time.
  • 18recurring processes across at least four tools for the estimated typical customer.
Source & limitations

Source: sample report, The Problem. The 64% and 47% figures come from a fictional, unaudited online survey of 240 U.S. and Canadian operations leaders in February 2026. The “18 processes / four tools” estimate comes from 60 fictional interviews conducted October 2025–March 2026. Survey responses reflect respondent opinion and may not generalize.

The product thesis

Turn recurring work into a governed operating system.

LumaFlow sits between general task management and enterprise automation: structured enough for control, lighter-weight enough for faster deployment.

Source, scope & derivation

Conclusion

The growth case is credible. Execution determines what follows.

Momentum

Revenue, customer count, conversion, usage, and retention improved.

Position

Deployment speed and mid-market subscription growth are the clearest advantages.

Watchpoints

Concentration, cloud cost, capacity, hiring, and product delivery constrain the outlook.

Historical evidence supports continued investment, but the $18.0M year-end ARR target remains separate from completed results.
